newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed after broker defaults.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed after broker defaults.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open mixed on Wednesday after the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) suspended the membership of a brokerage house for defaulting on a share transaction, dealers said.

A KSE statement said M. Rashid Jamal's MRJ Securities had been suspended for failing to pay money owed in share transactions and to deliver sold shares on Tuesday's settlement day. Company executives could not be reached for comment.
The KSE statement did not mention the amount involved but one broker said it could be more than 41 million rupees.
The Karachi 100-index on Tuesday dipped 6.73 points, or 0.43 percent, to 1,575.79 amid 184 losers and 58 gainers in a turnover of 39 million shares, down from 40 million on Monday.
